'''''Reclaimed Wreck''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]<ref name="CGP" /> created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> that depicted an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that had crashed and decayed on a [[Water/Legends|wetland]] filled with tall narrow [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and structures with [[Color/Legends|red]] coverings.<ref name="CGP" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Reclaimed Wreck'' appeared in "[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]," a collection of [[in-universe]] illustrations by [[Ryan Church]] collected in ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a [[2005]] [[Wikipedia:Graphic novel|graphic novel]] edited by [[Jeremy Barlow]].<ref name="CGP" />
